title: OCaml C interface, manual 5.3
finding: Protect before allocation; explicitly separate pending actions and return exceptions as typed results when cleanup must precede propagation.
limit: Learning mechanism only; neither Gambit ABI nor current Gambit allocation/callback policy is inferred.

title: Herlihy and Wing, Linearizability, 1990
finding: Specify one abstract observable commit between invocation and response.
limit: Does not establish actual C event mapping, memory visibility or external-effect recovery.

title: WG14 N1570 committee draft
finding: C concurrency and setjmp/longjmp restrictions; changed nonvolatile automatic locals are not a durable recovery ledger; cross-thread or dead-activation longjmp is undefined.
limit: Current header can choose builtins; actual compiler/builtin/Darwin ABI contract is not qualified.
